message.idle-warning: You will show as idle in {{seconds}} seconds. Press any key to stay active.
message.auto-sleep: You were idle, so you are going to bed. Press Cancel on the sleep screen to stay up.
block.not-multiplayer: Going to bed from anywhere only works in co-op.
block.festival: No sleeping on a festival day.
block.busy: Close the menu or dialogue first.
block.no-bed: There is no bed in your home.
config.note: Every player sets their own panel and idle tracking. In co-op the host's idle minutes and the idle counts as ready choice apply to every player who has the mod.
config.hud.name: Show the panel
config.hud.tooltip: Shows who is in bed and who is idle under the clock, in co-op only.
config.position.name: Panel position
config.position.tooltip: Top left is free in the game. Under the clock sits below the journal button and its new quest arrow, but other mods often put icons there too.
config.offset-x.name: Move panel right
config.offset-y.name: Move panel down
config.offset.tooltip: Pixels to move the panel from its position. Negative values move it the other way. The panel always stays on screen.
config.scale.name: Panel size
config.scale.tooltip: Size of the panel text. 1 is the game's own small text.
config.afk.name: Track idle time
config.afk.tooltip: Tells the other players when you have not touched anything for a while. Needed for idle players to show and to count as ready.
config.minutes.name: Minutes until idle
config.minutes.tooltip: Minutes without input before you show as idle. On a joined game the host's value is used.
config.warn.name: Warning (seconds)
config.warn.tooltip: Seconds before you show as idle when a message tells you. 0 turns the message off.
config.cursor.name: Mouse movement counts
config.cursor.tooltip: Moving the mouse keeps you active. Turn this off if a bumped mouse keeps a sleeping player marked active.
config.afk-ready.name: Idle counts as ready
config.afk-ready.tooltip: An idle player counts as ready in the panel. It does not end the night, everyone still has to be in bed. On a joined game the host's choice is used.
config.key.name: Go to bed key
config.key.tooltip: Takes you to your own bed from anywhere and starts the game's sleep check. You can press Cancel there. Co-op only.
config.auto.name: Go to bed when idle
config.auto.tooltip: When you are idle and another player is already in bed, you are sent to your own bed. Once a day, only you, and you can cancel.
